title: Privacy Policy
headings: Vendors that operate on our behalf
paragraphs: A clear explanation of what information Grow Green Weed Control collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you.
Contact our local office team to ask about your information or communication preferences.

We collect the information needed to prepare quotes, provide and improve services, manage customer accounts, communicate with customers, and operate our business. We do not sell mobile information or SMS consent for marketing.
This Privacy Policy explains how Grow Green Weed Control (“Grow Green,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, discloses, and protects personal information when you:
This policy does not govern a third-party website or service that has its own privacy policy.
The information we collect depends on how you interact with us and may include the following categories.
Name, service address, billing address, email address, telephone number, account identifiers, and similar contact details.

Property location, selected or requested services, lawn or landscape details, turf type, approximate treatment area, property-access information, gate or pet instructions, photos, service history, technician observations, treatment records, and information you ask us to consider when preparing or performing services.

Quote requests, estimates, accepted services, appointments, invoices, payment status, discounts, account preferences, customer-support records, and related business records. Payment-card details are handled as described in the “Payments” section below.

Messages, emails, form submissions, call notes, customer-support requests, reviews or feedback, SMS and email preferences, and records showing when and how you opted in or opted out of communications.

Internet Protocol address, browser type, device type, operating system, referring page, pages viewed, date and time of access, approximate location derived from an IP address, cookie identifiers, and general website-interaction information.

If you apply for a position, we may collect your contact information, resume, employment and education history, qualifications, licenses or certifications, availability, references, responses to application questions, and other information you choose to provide.
Please do not submit sensitive information that we have not requested through a general website form, text message, or email.
We may collect personal information:
We may use personal information to:

Our Site may use cookies, pixels, tags, local storage, logs, and similar technologies to operate website features, remember preferences, understand traffic, measure form and advertising performance, and help protect the Site.

Depending on the tools enabled on the Site, analytics or advertising providers such as Google or Meta may receive device and website-interaction information through their technologies. Those providers handle information under their own privacy policies. This website activity does not include the contents of your text messages, and we do not provide SMS opt-in data or SMS consent to advertising providers for their own marketing.

You can limit many cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may affect the operation of some Site features. You may also use the privacy and advertising controls offered by the applicable platform or device.
We do not sell personal information for money. We may disclose information in the following limited circumstances:

We may provide information to companies that help us operate our website, customer-management system, customer portal, communications, cloud storage, scheduling, mapping, payment processing, accounting, analytics, advertising measurement, document management, and other business functions. These providers may use information only as permitted by their agreements with us and applicable law.
We may disclose information to accountants, insurers, attorneys, consultants, and other professional advisers when reasonably necessary for their work.

We may disclose information when we reasonably believe it is necessary to comply with law or legal process; respond to lawful government requests; protect a person, property, or rights; investigate fraud or security incidents; or enforce an agreement.
Information may be transferred as part of a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, sale of assets, or similar business transaction, subject to applicable law.
We may disclose information when you direct us to do so or when disclosure is reasonably necessary to provide a service you requested.

If you affirmatively opt in, Grow Green may send SMS or MMS messages concerning estimate notifications and follow-ups, appointments, scheduling, technician arrival, service updates, billing or account notifications, and customer support. Message frequency varies, and message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase.
You may opt out by replying STOP to a message or by contacting us. Reply HELP for assistance. We may retain opt-in and opt-out records to document and honor your communication choices.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. This includes your mobile number, SMS opt-in data, and SMS consent. Vendors that help us deliver and manage text messages may process this information solely to provide those services to us and may not use it for their own marketing.
For complete program rules, please review our Terms & Conditions .

Payments may be processed by a third-party payment processor. Payment-card information is submitted to and handled by that processor under its security practices and privacy policy. Grow Green generally does not receive or store the complete payment-card number. We may receive limited transaction information such as the payer's name, billing contact details, payment method type, last four digits, payment status, amount, and transaction date.

We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including providing services, maintaining customer and treatment records, honoring communication preferences, processing transactions, resolving disputes, meeting legal or insurance requirements, and protecting our business. Retention periods vary according to the type of information and the reason it was collected.

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. No website, transmission method, or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure, so we cannot promise absolute security.

You may contact us to request reasonable access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information associated with you. Depending on the request, applicable law, and our need to verify your identity, we may ask for additional information. We may retain information when required or permitted for legal, security, transaction, treatment-record, dispute, or other legitimate business purposes.

Residents of some jurisdictions may have additional privacy rights. We will respond to valid requests as required by applicable law and will not unlawfully discriminate against a person for exercising a privacy right.

Our Site and services are intended for adults requesting property services and are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information online from a child under 13. If you believe a child has submitted personal information to us, please contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.

The Site may link to a customer portal, review platform, map, social network, payment provider, or other third-party service. We do not control the privacy or security practices of an independently operated third party. Review that party's privacy policy before providing information directly to it.

We may update this Privacy Policy as our practices, technology, services, or legal obligations change. We will post the revised policy on this page and update the effective date. Material changes apply prospectively unless applicable law permits or requires otherwise.
To ask a privacy question, update your information, change a communication preference, or submit a privacy request, contact:
We will review privacy requests and respond within a reasonable period consistent with applicable law.

Home / Privacy Policy

Your information

Privacy Policy

A clear explanation of what information Grow Green Weed Control collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you.

Effective September 2, 2026 Applies to our website, communications, and services

On this page

  1. Scope
  2. Information collected
  3. How we collect it
  4. How we use it
  5. Cookies & analytics
  6. How we disclose it
  7. SMS privacy
  8. Payments
  9. Retention & security
  10. Your choices
  11. Children's privacy
  12. Third-party links
  13. Policy changes
  14. Contact us

Privacy question?

Contact our local office team to ask about your information or communication preferences.

Email our office →
Our approach

We collect the information needed to prepare quotes, provide and improve services, manage customer accounts, communicate with customers, and operate our business. We do not sell mobile information or SMS consent for marketing.

1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how Grow Green Weed Control (“Grow Green,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, discloses, and protects personal information when you:

  • Visit growgreenweedcontrol.com or use a form or feature on the website.
  • Request a quote, ask a question, or sign up for lawn-care services.
  • Use our customer portal or interact with your customer account.
  • Communicate with us by telephone, text message, email, social media, or in person.
  • Receive services or service-related communications from us.
  • Apply for employment with Grow Green.

This policy does not govern a third-party website or service that has its own privacy policy.

2. Information we collect

The information we collect depends on how you interact with us and may include the following categories.

Contact and identifying information

Name, service address, billing address, email address, telephone number, account identifiers, and similar contact details.

Property and service information

Property location, selected or requested services, lawn or landscape details, turf type, approximate treatment area, property-access information, gate or pet instructions, photos, service history, technician observations, treatment records, and information you ask us to consider when preparing or performing services.

Quote, account, and transaction information

Quote requests, estimates, accepted services, appointments, invoices, payment status, discounts, account preferences, customer-support records, and related business records. Payment-card details are handled as described in the “Payments” section below.

Communications and consent records

Messages, emails, form submissions, call notes, customer-support requests, reviews or feedback, SMS and email preferences, and records showing when and how you opted in or opted out of communications.

Website and device information

Internet Protocol address, browser type, device type, operating system, referring page, pages viewed, date and time of access, approximate location derived from an IP address, cookie identifiers, and general website-interaction information.

Employment-application information

If you apply for a position, we may collect your contact information, resume, employment and education history, qualifications, licenses or certifications, availability, references, responses to application questions, and other information you choose to provide.

Please do not submit sensitive information that we have not requested through a general website form, text message, or email.

3. How we collect information

We may collect personal information:

  • Directly from you, such as when you request a quote, create or use an account, approve services, make a payment, contact us, submit an application, or communicate with our team.
  • Automatically from the Site, through cookies, logs, and similar technologies when you browse or interact with website features.
  • From service providers, such as our customer-management, communications, payment, website, scheduling, mapping, analytics, or advertising providers.
  • From referral and lead sources, such as a referral partner or advertising platform when you intentionally submit a request to be contacted by Grow Green.
  • From public or property-information sources, when reasonably necessary to review a service address, estimate property characteristics, or prepare a quote.

4. How we use information

We may use personal information to:

  • Review quote requests and recommend, price, schedule, and provide services.
  • Create and manage customer accounts, service records, routes, appointments, invoices, and payments.
  • Communicate about estimates, appointments, technician arrival, completed services, lawn conditions, account activity, billing, and customer support.
  • Honor communication preferences and maintain evidence of consent and opt-out requests.
  • Respond to questions, complaints, service concerns, or reservice requests.
  • Operate, maintain, secure, troubleshoot, and improve our Site, customer portal, systems, services, and business processes.
  • Understand website and advertising performance and improve the relevance of our outreach.
  • Evaluate job applicants and administer our hiring process.
  • Detect or prevent fraud, misuse, security incidents, or unlawful activity.
  • Comply with legal, tax, licensing, insurance, safety, and recordkeeping obligations; establish or defend legal claims; and enforce applicable agreements.
  • Carry out another purpose disclosed when the information is collected or authorized by you.

5. Cookies, analytics, and advertising technologies

Our Site may use cookies, pixels, tags, local storage, logs, and similar technologies to operate website features, remember preferences, understand traffic, measure form and advertising performance, and help protect the Site.

Depending on the tools enabled on the Site, analytics or advertising providers such as Google or Meta may receive device and website-interaction information through their technologies. Those providers handle information under their own privacy policies. This website activity does not include the contents of your text messages, and we do not provide SMS opt-in data or SMS consent to advertising providers for their own marketing.

You can limit many cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may affect the operation of some Site features. You may also use the privacy and advertising controls offered by the applicable platform or device.

6. How we disclose information

We do not sell personal information for money. We may disclose information in the following limited circumstances:

Vendors that operate on our behalf

We may provide information to companies that help us operate our website, customer-management system, customer portal, communications, cloud storage, scheduling, mapping, payment processing, accounting, analytics, advertising measurement, document management, and other business functions. These providers may use information only as permitted by their agreements with us and applicable law.

Professional advisers

We may disclose information to accountants, insurers, attorneys, consultants, and other professional advisers when reasonably necessary for their work.

Legal, safety, and security purposes

We may disclose information when we reasonably believe it is necessary to comply with law or legal process; respond to lawful government requests; protect a person, property, or rights; investigate fraud or security incidents; or enforce an agreement.

Business transactions

Information may be transferred as part of a merger, acquisition, financing, reorganization, sale of assets, or similar business transaction, subject to applicable law.

At your direction

We may disclose information when you direct us to do so or when disclosure is reasonably necessary to provide a service you requested.

SMS privacy commitment: Mobile information, text-messaging originator opt-in data, and SMS consent will not be sold or shared with third parties or affiliates for their own marketing or promotional purposes.

7. SMS communications and mobile-data privacy

If you affirmatively opt in, Grow Green may send SMS or MMS messages concerning estimate notifications and follow-ups, appointments, scheduling, technician arrival, service updates, billing or account notifications, and customer support. Message frequency varies, and message and data rates may apply. Consent is not a condition of purchase.

You may opt out by replying STOP to a message or by contacting us. Reply HELP for assistance. We may retain opt-in and opt-out records to document and honor your communication choices.

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. This includes your mobile number, SMS opt-in data, and SMS consent. Vendors that help us deliver and manage text messages may process this information solely to provide those services to us and may not use it for their own marketing.

For complete program rules, please review our Terms & Conditions.

8. Payments

Payments may be processed by a third-party payment processor. Payment-card information is submitted to and handled by that processor under its security practices and privacy policy. Grow Green generally does not receive or store the complete payment-card number. We may receive limited transaction information such as the payer's name, billing contact details, payment method type, last four digits, payment status, amount, and transaction date.

9. Data retention and security

Retention

We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, including providing services, maintaining customer and treatment records, honoring communication preferences, processing transactions, resolving disputes, meeting legal or insurance requirements, and protecting our business. Retention periods vary according to the type of information and the reason it was collected.

Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. No website, transmission method, or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure, so we cannot promise absolute security.

10. Your privacy choices

You may contact us to request reasonable access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information associated with you. Depending on the request, applicable law, and our need to verify your identity, we may ask for additional information. We may retain information when required or permitted for legal, security, transaction, treatment-record, dispute, or other legitimate business purposes.

  • Text messages: Reply STOP or contact our office to revoke SMS consent.
  • Email: Use an unsubscribe link when provided or ask our office to stop nonessential promotional email.
  • Cookies: Use your browser or applicable platform controls to limit cookies and advertising technologies.
  • Account details: Contact our office to update inaccurate contact, property, or communication-preference information.

Residents of some jurisdictions may have additional privacy rights. We will respond to valid requests as required by applicable law and will not unlawfully discriminate against a person for exercising a privacy right.

11. Children's privacy

Our Site and services are intended for adults requesting property services and are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information online from a child under 13. If you believe a child has submitted personal information to us, please contact us so we can review and take appropriate action.

12. Third-party links and services

The Site may link to a customer portal, review platform, map, social network, payment provider, or other third-party service. We do not control the privacy or security practices of an independently operated third party. Review that party's privacy policy before providing information directly to it.

13. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as our practices, technology, services, or legal obligations change. We will post the revised policy on this page and update the effective date. Material changes apply prospectively unless applicable law permits or requires otherwise.

14. Contact us

To ask a privacy question, update your information, change a communication preference, or submit a privacy request, contact:

Grow Green Weed Control

We will review privacy requests and respond within a reasonable period consistent with applicable law.

(225) 461-3199 office@growgreenweedcontrol.com 14464 L Keller Rd, St. Amant, LA 70774
